title: Blow-up of a represented current on the form g·β: η_{a,t#}C(ω) = t^{−n}∫ g(η_{a,t}y)·ξ(y)(β) dμ
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n), and R an IMRep(univ, n) with R.Represents C; put μ := R.measure and ξ := R.orient. Let a ∈ ℝ^P, t > 0, g : ℝ^P → ℝ, β ∈ Covector(ℝ^P, n), and ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) (TestFormOn univ n) with ω(x) = g(x)·β for every x. Then currentEval(blowUp C a t, ω) = t^{−n}·∫ g(dilation a t y)·ξ(y)(β) dμ(y).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (a : Euclid P) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t) (g : Euclid P → ℝ) (β : Covector (Euclid P) n) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), R.Represents C → (∀ x, (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x = g x • β) → currentEval (blowUp C a t ht.ne') (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) = t⁻¹ ^ n * ∫ y, g (dilation a t y) * R.orient y β ∂R.measure
